name: ibis budget Singapore West Coast
short_description: A 2-star budget hotel on Pasir Panjang Road near West Coast Park, about a 5-minute drive from NUS and 15 minutes from VivoCity.
ai_summary: ibis budget Singapore West Coast sits at 418 Pasir Panjang Road, at the far end near Clementi Road, roughly a 5-minute drive from the National University of Singapore and Dover MRT Station and about 15 minutes from VivoCity and Sentosa Island. Formerly branded Fragrance Hotel - Waterfront, the property leans into its greener setting next to West Coast Park, home to the Marsh Gardens, a small lake, and an Adventure Playground. Its own Accor listing shows a 4.2/5 guest rating from 106 reviews, while TripAdvisor shows a more mixed 3/5 from about 98 reviews, with guests calling rooms small but clean and the location convenient for NUS and buses, though limited on nightlife or dining options nearby. The hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme.

core_facts.elite_notes: This hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, per its own Accor listing; ALL member rates may still apply but no points-earning or elite benefits are offered.

faqs.question: Is ibis budget Singapore West Coast part of the ALL loyalty programme?
faqs.answer: No -- despite the ibis budget/Accor branding, this hotel's own Accor listing confirms it does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, so members cannot earn or redeem points or elite benefits here, though ALL member rates may still apply.

faqs.question: How close is ibis budget Singapore West Coast to NUS?
faqs.answer: It's about a 5-minute drive (roughly 1 km, or a 10-minute walk) from the National University of Singapore, with a bus stop directly outside the hotel and Kent Ridge Bus Terminal about 200 metres away, making it a practical budget base for visitors to the campus area.
